denominator: n_requests - the measured requests only. Warm-ups are excluded from both numerator and denominator; including them would inflate the denominator with requests whose cost is not the steady state.
claim_tested: Round-1 .out showed 1 request in 20 doing 4 RTT instead of 2, and recorded the rate as unestimable at n=20.
percentile_method: nearest rank over the raw per-request sample list
